(2) shouldCompressContentType to skip images, videos, archives. (3) compressBrotli and compressGzip functions with configurable compression level. (4) decompressGzip and decompressBrotli for incoming request bodies. (5) compressResponseBody with 1KB threshold check. (6) compressionMiddleware for integration with HTTP layer. (7) getCompressionConfigFromEnv for environment-based configuration. (8) Comprehensive test suite with 20+ test cases covering all acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria_met: Responses over 1KB are compressed when client supports it
Brotli is preferred over gzip when both accepted
Content-Encoding header is set correctly on compressed responses
Responses under 1KB skip compression to avoid overhead
Image and archive content types are never compressed
Incoming compressed request bodies are decompressed before handler processing
Compression level is configurable via environment variable
